+"""RoboPaint-strict stroke-copy controller for eai-standard/2.2.
+
+Paper millimetres use the task's image coordinates.  The canvas camera
+calibration gives world x = 0.013592 - Y and world y = 0.113592 - X.
+The paint wells were mapped in scene_cam and depth from the live episode.
+"""
+import sys, time, json, math
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+MM = 0.001
+SURFACE = 0.0202
+QDOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])
+# Index follows static.wells.wells.  Centers in world metres, observed by
+# unprojecting the 10 visible palette circles at their well surface.
+WELLS = [
+    (-.1600, .1400), (-.1280, .1400), (-.0960, .1400), (-.0640, .1400), (-.0320, .1400),
+    (-.1600, .1720), (-.1280, .1720), (-.0960, .1720), (-.0640, .1720), (-.0320, .1720),
+]
+
+def paper_xy_mm(X, Y):
+    """Map target-image mm to world x,y (image left/top are X=Y=0)."""
+    return (0.013592 - Y*MM, 0.113592 - X*MM)
+
+def pose_xy(x, y, z):
+    return np.array([x, y, z, *QDOWN], dtype=float)
+
+def send_target(r, p, video="none"):
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(p, dtype=float).reshape(1, 7), dt=.05, video=video)
+
+def move(r, x, y, z):
+    res = send_target(r, pose_xy(x, y, z))
+    if res.meta.get("rejected") or res.meta.get("n_clipped", 0):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"move failed: {res.meta}")
+    return res
+
+def move_paper(r, Xmm, Ymm, z):
+    x, y = paper_xy_mm(Xmm, Ymm)
+    return move(r, x, y, z)
+
+def dip(r, idx):
+    x, y = WELLS[idx]
+    move(r, x, y, .09)
+    return move(r, x, y, .018)
+
+def stroke(r, pts_mm, z=SURFACE-.001):
+    """Execute a single continuous contact sweep through paper-mm points."""
+    pts = [paper_xy_mm(x, y) for x, y in pts_mm]
+    x0, y0 = pts[0]
+    move(r, x0, y0, z+.025)
+    move(r, x0, y0, z)
+    last = None
+    for (xa, ya), (xb, yb) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
+        length = math.hypot(xb-xa, yb-ya)
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(length/.008)))
+        for t in np.linspace(0, 1, n+1)[1:]:
+            last = send_target(r, pose_xy(xa+(xb-xa)*t, ya+(yb-ya)*t, z))
+    move(r, pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1], z+.025)
+    return last
+
+def practice_calibration(r):
+    # A straight 50 mm sweep at three tuft penetrations; separated on the
+    # practice sheet so the camera makes width comparison easy.
+    for idx, yrow, z in [(0, 24, .0192), (1, 50, .0150), (2, 76, .0100)]:
+        dip(r, idx)
+        x, y = paper_xy_mm(75, yrow)
+        move(r, x, y, .07)
+        stroke(r, [(75, yrow), (325, yrow)], z=z)
+    # Save observations and status so calibration remains reviewable.
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam", "side_cam"], depth=True)
+    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(f"/app/output/cal_{name}.png")
+    if hasattr(obs, "last_depth"):
+        for name, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+            np.save(f"/app/output/cal_{name}_depth.npy", depth)
+    print(json.dumps({"status": r.status(), "tip": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10]}))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    r = Robot()
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "calibrate":
+        practice_calibration(r)
+    else:
+        print(json.dumps({"status": r.status(), "tip": r.get_obs().meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10]}))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
